## Schedule {#schedule}

Twenty-eight meetings in two parts. **Part I — Foundations** (sessions 1–12)
builds the whole pipeline on tabular data: you work by hand through session 7,
and AI enters at session 8. **Part II — Applications** (sessions 13–28) takes
one data family per session through the same pipeline, with wide delegation to
AI and verification as the graded skill.

Topics link to their session page once it is published; the sidebar lists the
same pages.

::: {.schedule}
{{< include _schedule.qmd >}}
:::

## Homework

Thirteen assignments, out on Thursdays and due the following Thursday at 8:40 am.
Each one is an investigation against real data, not an exercise set. The last is
a two-week assignment.

::: {.tight-cols}
{{< include _hw_calendar.qmd >}}
:::

Full homework policy — late work, peer review, disclosure, and how submissions
are graded — is in the [syllabus](syllabus.qmd).

::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
Break dates (Tue Oct 13, Thu Nov 26) are taken from the Fall 2026 academic
calendar and still need registrar confirmation.
:::
